verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in servers is a software or agent role, not something a CPU can do, so the story is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships any MCP client capability. Its AI features are hardware acceleration and toolkits (NPU, OpenVINO, oneAPI) for running inference, not tool integration.
